title: Senior Engineering Manager - Backend
description: P-995 Sr. Engineering Manager (M4) Location: Bangalore, India At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started. You will lead engineering teams building infrastructure and products for the Databricks platform at scale. Your teams work across multiple domains including resource management infrastructure, scalable cloud services, cross-cloud operational tooling, and machine learning infrastructure that powers big data and ML workloads in a secure, cloud-agnostic way. The Impact You Will Have - Build and scale world-class engineering teams by hiring top talent and developing engineering leaders who raise the bar across the organization. - Drive technical excellence by establishing strong engineering practices including architecture reviews, testing standards, and operational discipline to ensure high-quality, reliable systems. - Partner with engineering and product leadership to define long-term technical strategy and roadmap that aligns with business objectives. - Ensure consistent delivery of complex, multi-team initiatives by coordinating execution and removing blockers across organizational boundaries. - Maintain high service quality and reliability standards across owned services, including SLAs and production operational excellence. - Provide clear feedback and coaching to help engineers and managers grow their careers and technical capabilities. What We Look For - 10+ years of software engineering experience. - 4+ years managing engineering teams, including experience leading managers. - Proven track record building and scaling high-performing engineering teams, including hiring and developing senior technical talent and engineering leaders. - Deep experience with large-scale distributed systems, including responsibility for testing, monitoring, SLAs, and production operational excellence. - Ability to define technical strategy and drive execution of complex initiatives spanning multiple teams and system boundaries. - Strong partnership skills working cross-functionally with product management, sales, and customers to deliver innovative solutions. - Experience managing distributed teams across geographies is preferred. - B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram . Benefits At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees.
